Your Complete Study Abroad Support System

An end-to-end 8-step support system designed to take you smoothly from career counseling to your university campus abroad.

01

Career Counselling

Confused about your future? Get 1-on-1 expert advice tailored strictly to your academic goals and budget.

02

Test Preparation

Boost your scores with expert IELTS, PTE, TOEFL & SAT coaching, real exam strategies, and full mock test series.

03

Application Assistance

Maximize your chances of admission with error-free file processing, professional SOP review, and LOR verification.

04

University Selection

We shortlist top QS ranked universities where you have the highest chance of acceptance & scholarship approval.

05

Scholarship Matching

Identify and apply for institutional merit grants, bursaries, and fully-funded government scholarships worldwide.

06

Visa Processing & Drills

Rigorous embassy file preparation, financial proofing, and realistic mock interviews with seasoned visa experts.

07

Financial Guidance

Complete assistance with student education loan approvals, blocked account opening, and currency forex exchange.

08

Pre Departure Briefing

Flight bookings, student housing allocation, airport pickup, and connecting with our international alumni network.

About DreamSky

Empowering Nepal's Students To Reach Global Heights

Established in Kathmandu, DreamSky Education Consultancy is Nepal's trusted gateway to higher education abroad. We specialize in university placements, test preparation (IELTS, PTE, SAT), financial counseling, and guaranteed visa support for Australia, UK, USA, Canada, New Zealand & Europe.

Government Approved

MOEST approved (Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Nepal) & TITI certified education counselors ensuring 100% legal & transparent processing.

100% Verified Consultancy

300+ Partner Universities

Direct alliances with top QS ranked institutions worldwide, unlocking generous merit scholarships, tuition grants, and seamless credit transfers.

Global Network

98.5% Visa Success

Rigorous mock embassy interview drills, SOP verification, and financial documentation tailored to embassy guidelines.

High Visa Approval Rate
